material_or_record: Surgical PT+LM+NC+NL (or paired PT+LM) specimens with zero patient overlap against GSE245552/164522/203608/178318/335552
primary_readout: Canonical donor_uid with treatment window and synchronous/metachronous interval and liver fibrosis/steatosis and growth pattern
mandatory_controls_and_checks: Verify independent patient identity and batch-balance paired tissues from the same donor on the same staining run
decision_or_stopping_rule: Patient (donor_uid) is the sole unit of independent replication; never pool metachronous post-chemo tissues silently

material_or_record: Paired H&E and duplex RNA ISH (SPP1 + CXCL9) + myeloid identity (CD68/CD163/C1QA) + EPCAM exclusion + adjacent/co-registered CD3+CD8+ staining
primary_readout: Patient-level joint myeloid phenotype proportion q_{i,t} and four-tissue interaction I_i = (q_LM - q_PT) - (q_NL - q_NC)
mandatory_controls_and_checks: Blinded pathologist delineation of viable tumor core vs invasive margin vs adjacent parenchyma vs perinecrotic rim before viewing SPP1/CXCL9; threshold locked on ~6 separate calibration cases
decision_or_stopping_rule: Do not delete necrotic rim to claim necrosis-independence and do not claim 2-marker ISH validates the full 160-gene block; stop mechanism claims if I_i is explained by D_N or necrosis

material_or_record: 4-6 independent calibration human donors (paired MDM or fresh CRLM TAM + autologous live CD3+CD8+ T cells)
primary_readout: Baseline SPP1 mRNA/intracellular/secreted protein and R/C/A markers (CXCL9/10 and HLA-DRA/CD74) plus migration dynamic range
mandatory_controls_and_checks: Confirm baseline SPP1 is well above lower limit of quantification before perturbation (M-CSF alone does not guarantee TAM state; Li 2023 B46)
decision_or_stopping_rule: Abort knockdown in any model system lacking baseline SPP1 or target state; calibration donors are excluded from confirmatory N

material_or_record: Autologous donor blocks across Baseline vs prespecified IFN-gamma background x (NT_Ctrl | SPP1_KD | SPP1_Rescue_Endo | SPP1_KD+rhSPP1_Ext)
primary_readout: Donor-level paired delta_{d,c} and interaction Gamma_d = delta_{d,IFN} - delta_{d,Baseline} on live migrated CD3+CD8+ / input live CD3+CD8+
mandatory_controls_and_checks: >=2 non-overlapping sequences; verify knockdown and physiological endogenous rescue in BOTH backgrounds; compare endogenous rescue vs physiological extracellular rhSPP1 to separate secreted ligand from intracellular IFN feedback (Sun Immunity 2026 B43)
decision_or_stopping_rule: Withhold biological interpretation if viability drops or knockdown efficiency differs across backgrounds; if only endogenous rescue (not physiological rhSPP1) reverses phenotype classify as intracellular regulation

material_or_record: Conditioned medium normalized by viable myeloid count and collection window + Transwell chambers with coded blinded flow-bead counting
primary_readout: Migrated live CD3+CD8+ / input live CD3+CD8+ fraction (with equal-concentration zero-gradient chemokinesis control reported separately per M7 §A2.3)
mandatory_controls_and_checks: Mandatory equal-concentration upper+lower chamber chemokinesis control + cell-free IFN-gamma washout carryover control + blank/positive chemokine controls
decision_or_stopping_rule: Distinguish true directional chemotaxis from chemokinesis or residual IFN-gamma carryover; average technical wells within donor first

material_or_record: Triggered ONLY if primary directional chemotaxis contrast passes: anti-CXCL9/10 neutralizing antibodies vs isotype IgG in both NT_Ctrl and SPP1_KD CM
primary_readout: Attenuation of (SPP1_KD - NT_Ctrl) migration difference while retaining above-floor migration dynamic range
mandatory_controls_and_checks: Apply identical antibody/isotype concentration to both NT_Ctrl and SPP1_KD CM (avoid anti-CD44 alone as SPP1-specific proof due to multi-ligand binding)
decision_or_stopping_rule: Support partial CXCL9/10 dependence only if difference shrinks without floor collapse across all arms; stop at migration without claiming tumor killing

material_or_record: Prospective donor enrollment based on calibration variance s_donor of I_i or Gamma_d and attrition rate
primary_readout: Two-sided donor-level 95% confidence interval half-width h and prespecified minimum biologically meaningful effect
mandatory_controls_and_checks: Randomize plate well positions across experimental days and maintain analyst blinding until analysis lock
decision_or_stopping_rule: Report all enrolled donors and failed wells transparently; conclude evidence insufficient when intervals remain wide rather than cherry-picking wells or ROIs
